Welcome to use BYD Karaoke System!
 In order to protect your rights and interests, please accept the BYD Vehicle System User Agreement and the BYD Vehicle System Privacy Statement before using BYD Karaoke System (hereinafter referred to as the System). And you should carefully read and agree with all the contents of these instructions for use. You understand and agree that your use of the System will be deemed that you have understood and accepted these instructions.
 1. The system is an on-board karaoke system provided to you by BYD Automobile Industry Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as BYD or We). Before using the System, please pair the microphone with the vehicle (receiver) first. Refer to the Microphone Manual for details of the pairing method. Some BYD models pre-installed with the System may not be equipped with karaoke microphone hardware (subject to the specific model configuration). If you need to enable this feature, please purchase the karaoke microphone hardware from BYD DiLink Mall separately.
 2. During the use of the System, it is necessary to ensure that your BYD DiLink system is continuously connected to the network. The operation of the System requires the third-party karaoke applications installed on your mobile phone or vehicle (subject to the software actually installed in your vehicle). You should also accept and abide by the user instructions documents (such as User Agreement, Privacy Statement) and Manuals of these third-party karaoke applications. At the same time, you understand and agree that if the System and related functions become abnormal due to reasons not attributable to the System (such as third-party karaoke application failure, microphone failure, force majeure, other circumstances that we cannot reasonably foresee in advance), BYD shall not assume the responsibility.
